notes.title: New patch - July 4th
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342702/5ce38aee1d29b1a82b79d30272e59ecd71877444.jpgA new patch is now available, here's the fixlist.

- Introduced Tests in Managerial career
- Various fixes in Managerial Career
- AI improvement: now AI riders may incur in unforced falls
- Fixed Off-track help being reset
- Fixed missing backfire from several bikes
- Fixed "From rookie to talent" Trophy unlocking conditions
- Fixed weather randomization in Managerial Career
- Fixed wrong riding style selected for online modes

Tests, mentioned in the first point, will let you speed up your R&D by completing specific challenges on given tracks.

Thank you all for reporting issues. Please remember, in case of technical difficulties, that our Customer Support answers here: http://milestone.it/supporto/?lang=en

notes.title: New patch available now
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342702/73aa413047c3d15203318223e1104d9662a905d8.jpgHello everyone, and first of all thanks for reporting and sorry for any inconvenience.
Here is the fixlist for the just released patch.

-Fixed random crash in single player and multiplayer modes.
-Improved stability in multiplayer modes.
-Fixed crash at start on PCs missing proper Media Pack (installing Media Pack still highly recommended).
-Various fixes in Managerial Career: Staff management, Emails, R&D, Activities.
-Improved tyre and bike damage status HUD.
-Improved online stability.

Please keep reporting in case you encounter further issues. Also remember that our Customer Support answers here, and it's the only efficient way for us to track and solve bugs: http://milestone.it/supporto/?lang=en

Thank you all
